text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its future prospects and its role in my whole portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my personal average cost; selling winners just to lock in a gain can leave me holding weaker positions.","My frequent account checks and several trades a month can encourage impulsive decisions, so I should set clear reasons for trading and avoid acting on ordinary price moves alone.","These few months of gains and losses do not reveal a reliable price pattern; past changes are random and should not be treated as predictions of what comes next."]}
